idea-plugin.name: Agent CLI
idea-plugin.description:
• Agent CLI tool window with an embedded terminal and a compact session sidebar.
  • Support for Claude Code, Cursor agent, and Gemini CLI — start a session for the agent you use from the + menu.
  • Multiple sessions — create, switch, and close sessions; session history for the current project with resume by session ID where local agent data is available.
  • Theme-aware terminal — colors follow the IDE look-and-feel where applicable.
  • Settings (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI) — configure each agent's launch command and terminal font size.

Note: A JetBrains Runtime with JCEF is required for the embedded terminal. Install and sign in to each agent CLI you use separately.
